# .github/workflows/

GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows.

## Files

| File                 | What                               | When to read                              |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `publish-to-npm.yml` | Automates NPM package publishing   | Modifying the release process             |
| `ci.yml`             | Dockerized checks on PRs and `stable` pushes | Changing CI checks              |
| `release-binary.yml` | Builds and attaches Linux binaries on published releases | Changing binary releases |
